suppress.notes: Guava 30.1.1 reaches the tree only through the ErrorProne dataflow shading on the annotationProcessor and compile classpaths. ErrorProne runs at compile time and ships nothing, so CVE-2023-2976 (temp-directory file disclosure) cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.
plexus-utils 3.3.0 is a build-tool transitive that stays on the checkstyle configuration, so CVE-2025-67030 cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.
Rhino 1.7.15 is pulled only by PMD's pmd-javascript module on the cpd configuration, so CVE-2025-66453 cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.

httpclient5 5.5.2 reaches the tree only through PMD's Saxon and xmlresolver dependencies on the pmd and cpd configurations. Those tools run at build time and ship nothing, so CVE-2026-71290 cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.

httpcore5 and httpcore5-h2 5.3.6 reach the tree only through xmlresolver and httpclient5 on the pmd and cpd configurations. Those tools run at build time and ship nothing, so CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428 cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.

jline 3.21.0 is one shaded jar that reports nine package URLs. It reaches the tree only through PMD's progressbar dependency on the cpd configuration. CPD runs at build time and ships nothing, so CVE-2026-56740 and CVE-2026-56741 (Telnet server) cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.

False match on the jetbrains:kotlin CPE. JetBrains describes CVE-2026-53914 as code execution through unsafe deserialization in the build cache metadata (KT-86604, severity Medium, CVSS 6.7) at https://www.jetbrains.com/privacy-security/issues-fixed/. kotlin-stdlib 2.2.21 has no reader for build cache metadata. NVD's 9.8 comes from the product-wide CPE. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.

Same false match as kotlin-stdlib. kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 and kotlin-stdlib-jdk8 2.2.21 are also only on the cpd configuration, through PMD's language modules, so CVE-2026-53914 cannot run in the application. Verified 2026-10-31, ticket betterreads#221.
